content.src: 又过了会儿，韩立只觉腰间一紧，身子一轻，整个人突然自动的往上升
content.target: After a while, Han Li felt a tightness around his waist, his body lightened, and suddenly he began to rise automatically.

content.src: 韩立转头一看，却是那位紧跟在自己身后的师兄一手抱着自己，另一手和双腿敏捷的向上攀升，韩立同时注意到太阳高高的挂在天上正中间
content.target: Han Li turned his head and saw that it was the senior brother who had been closely following him, holding him with one hand while skillfully climbing upward with the other hand and legs. At the same time, Han Li noticed the sun was high in the middle of the sky.

content.src: 原来自己终于还是没能完成这段路程，韩立心里有点难过，自己那么拼命，怎吗还是比不上别人那
content.target: It turned out he still couldn't complete the journey. Han Li felt a bit sad inside. He had tried so hard, but why was he still not as good as others?

content.src: 转眼到了山崖顶部，眼前只有六名小童盘坐在一旁休息，而舞岩正和一位身穿深蓝员外袍，背负着双手，五十余岁富态老者说话，岳堂主和王护法都正站在他的身旁，两人身旁还站了数人，正一起等着那些青年师兄一个个将其他较慢的童子送上山来
content.target: In the blink of an eye, they reached the top of the cliff. Only six children were sitting there resting, while Wu Yan was talking to a plump, wealthy-looking man in his fifties wearing a dark blue robe, with his hands behind his back. Hall Master Yue and Protector Wang were standing beside him, along with several others, waiting for the senior brothers to bring up the slower children one by one.

content.src: 等了一会儿所有的孩童都被送了上来，这时岳堂主走前一步，肃然的面对众童子
content.target: After a while, all the children were brought up. Then Hall Master Yue stepped forward and faced the children solemnly.

content.src: “这次合格者共七人，其中六人进入本堂百锻堂，正式成为本门内门弟子
content.target: "There are seven qualifiers this time. Six of them will enter the Hundred Forging Hall of our sect and officially become inner disciples."

content.src: ”他的缓缓的说道
content.target: He said slowly.

content.src: “另一人舞岩，第一个到达山崖，表现杰出，直接保送到七绝堂学习本门绝技
content.target: "The other one, Wu Yan, was the first to reach the cliff and performed outstandingly. He will be directly sent to the Seven Mysteries Hall to learn our sect's secret techniques."

content.src: ”岳堂主回头望了一眼穿员外袍的老者，老者手捻胡须，满意的冲他点了下头
content.target: Hall Master Yue glanced back at the robed elder, who stroked his beard and nodded at him in satisfaction.

content.src:
“至于其他人……，”岳堂主打量了几下其余童子，用右手轻轻地摸了摸自己的下巴，稍微沉吟了一会儿便道：

“张铁，韩立，两人虽然未按时到达崖顶，但表现突出，看来能吃得习武之苦，你们二人先在本门跟几名教习打下根基，半年后再考核一下，合格则正式成为内门弟子，未合格则送到外门当外门弟子处理
content.target: "As for the others..." Hall Master Yue looked at the remaining children, gently touched his chin with his right hand, pondered for a moment, and then said, "Zhang Tie and Han Li, although they didn't reach the cliff on time, showed remarkable effort and seem capable of enduring the hardships of martial arts training. You two will first train with some instructors to build a foundation. After half a year, you'll be tested again. If you pass, you'll officially become inner disciples. If not, you'll be sent to the outer sect as outer disciples."

content.src:
”

韩立望了一眼另一名同时站出来，叫张铁的童子，他正是紧跟自己身后，也吊在绳索上，差一点爬到崖顶的人
content.target: Han Li glanced at another boy who also stepped forward, named Zhang Tie. He was the one who had been right behind Han Li, hanging on the rope and almost made it to the top of the cliff.

content.src: “王护法，剩下之人每人领些银子，全都送遣回家
content.target: "Guardian Wang, give some silver to each of the remaining boys and send them all home."

content.src: ”岳堂主冷冷的看着最后剩下的童子
content.target: Hall Master Yue coldly stared at the last remaining boy.

content.src: “遵命
content.target: "Understood."

content.src:
”

王护法踏步而出，恭身领命，把未过关的童子领下山崖
content.target: Guardian Wang stepped forward, bowed respectfully to accept the order, and led the boys who failed the test down the cliff.

content.src: “张均，吴铭瑞，你二人把这些过关之人带到本堂去，把他们分别交于顾副堂主和李教习
content.target: "Zhang Jun, Wu Mingrui, take these successful candidates to the main hall and assign them to Deputy Hall Master Gu and Instructor Li."

content.src:
”

又有两名青年领命走了出来，把韩立他们分成了两组，朝山崖下走去，其中一人正是那位冷冰冰的师兄
content.target: Two more young men stepped forward to accept the order. They divided Han Li and the others into two groups and led them down the cliff. One of them was that cold-faced senior brother.

content.src: 临下山崖时，韩立忍不住看了一眼舞岩，现他仍和那位蓝袍老者说话，没有丝毫动身的样子
content.target: As they were about to leave the cliff, Han Li couldn’t help but glance at Wu Yan, who was still talking to the blue-robed elder, showing no sign of moving.

content.src: “他和你们不一样，是被送到七绝堂的核心弟子，一旦学成出来，最起码也是个护法身份
content.target: "He’s different from you all. He’s a core disciple sent to the Seven Mysteries Hall. Once he completes his training, he’ll at least become a guardian."

content.src: ”另一名瘦长脸师兄似乎看出了韩立心中的疑问，主动进行了解惑，可在他的话语中，似乎带了一丝说不清的羡慕和嫉妒的味道
content.target: The other senior brother, with a long and thin face, seemed to notice Han Li’s confusion and explained voluntarily. However, his tone carried a hint of inexplicable envy and jealousy.

content.src: “还不是仗着有个当副门主的表姐夫，要不是他有个表姐嫁给了马副门主做了续弦夫人，不然凭他
content.target: “He only got in because his cousin is married to the deputy sect master. If it weren’t for his cousin being the deputy sect master’s second wife, with his

content.src: 年龄都过了入门要求，还能进七绝堂
content.target: age already past the entry requirements, how could he have joined the Seven Mysteries Sect?”

content.src: ”冷冰冰的师兄说的话让人都觉得背后有一股冷冷的凉气在往上冒
content.target: The cold-faced senior brother’s words sent a chill down everyone’s spine.

content.src: “张均，你不要命了，副门主也是我们能胡乱议论的人
content.target: “Zhang Jun, are you out of your mind? The deputy sect master isn’t someone we can casually gossip about.”

content.src: 要是被其他同门听到，你我都逃不了面壁悔过的惩戒
content.target: If other disciples hear this, neither of us will escape the punishment of wall-facing repentance.”

content.src: ”瘦长脸的师兄听了冷冷师兄的话，吃了一惊，慌忙四处察看一番，看到除了这几位小童没有其他外人，这才松了一口气
content.target: The thin-faced senior brother was startled by the cold-faced one’s words. He quickly looked around and, seeing no outsiders except these few children, finally relaxed.

content.src: 冷冷的师兄冷哼了一声，似乎心里也有些顾忌，便不再言语了，韩立这时才知道这位冷冷的师兄叫张均
content.target: The cold-faced senior brother snorted but seemed to think better of it and fell silent. Han Li now knew this cold-faced senior brother was named Zhang Jun.

content.src: 对他们说的话韩立心里似懂非懂，但隐隐约约的知道，舞岩并非靠真才实学进的那个七绝堂，而是因为门内有个副门主的亲戚做靠山，才能毫不费力得以进入
content.target: Han Li only vaguely understood their words, but he sensed that Wu Yan hadn’t entered the Seven Mysteries Sect on merit—he had a deputy sect master’s relative backing him.

content.src: 走在山路上，这两位师兄心里都想起了门内令人感到沮丧的一些事情，再也没有心情开口说话，只是默默地领着他们往前走，而韩立等人更是不敢私下里说话，也许他们心里都已隐约的意识到七玄门和在家中一些不一样的地方
content.target: Walking along the mountain path, the two senior brothers were lost in thoughts of the sect’s disheartening affairs. They led the group in silence, and Han Li and the others dared not speak either, perhaps sensing that the Seven Mysteries Sect was different from home.

content.src: 在经过一片茂密的树林时，从林子里缓缓走出一老人，这人六十余岁，长的高高瘦瘦，面皮焦黄，却留有一头长到披肩的白，这老者一边走一边不停的恭着身子咳嗽，看他咳嗽的辛苦样子，似乎他随时都有倒下的可能，令人十分担心
content.target: As they passed through a dense forest, an elderly man slowly emerged. He was in his sixties, tall and thin, with sallow skin and shoulder-length white hair. Hunched over, he coughed incessantly, looking so frail it seemed he might collapse at any moment.

content.src: 张均二人一见此人，却没有一点担心的样子，反而急忙走上前去，恭恭敬敬地对这名老者深施一礼
content.target: When Zhang Jun and the other saw this person, they showed no sign of worry. Instead, they quickly stepped forward and bowed respectfully to the old man.

content.src: “墨大夫，您老人家好，有升吗事要吩咐弟子做吗
content.target: "Doctor Mo, how are you, sir? Is there anything you need us to do?"

content.src: ”张均一反以往冷冷的神情，脸上充满了敬意，对他来说，这名老者比堂主，甚至副门主更值得尊敬
content.target: "Zhang Jun, who was usually cold, now looked full of respect. To him, this old man deserved more respect than the hall master or even the deputy sect leader."

content.src: “哦，这是刚上山的新来弟子吗
content.target: "Oh, are these new disciples who just came up the mountain?"

content.src: ”老者终于止住咳嗽，用沙哑的声音缓缓地问道
content.target: "The old man finally stopped coughing and asked slowly in a hoarse voice."

content.src: “是的
content.target: "Yes."

content.src: 这些人中有六名正式弟子，两名记名第子
content.target: "Among them, six are full disciples, and two are probationary disciples."

content.src: ”张均仔细的回答道
content.target: "Zhang Jun answered carefully."

content.src: “我现在人手不够，还缺一名炼药童子和一名采药弟子，这两人跟我走吧
content.target: "I'm short on help now. I need a medicine-refining assistant and a herb-gathering disciple. These two will come with me."

content.src: ”这名墨大夫随手一指，正好指向韩立等两名记名弟子，话语中充满了令人不容置疑的语气
content.target: "Doctor Mo pointed casually, right at Han Li and the other probationary disciple. His tone left no room for doubt."

content.src: “遵命，这二人是记名弟子，能被墨大夫您老看中，是他们二人的福气，还不过来给墨老见礼，要是能学到他老人家一两手医术，是你们二人一生的造化
content.target: "As you command. These two are registered disciples. It's their fortune to be noticed by you, Elder Mo. Come and greet Elder Mo. If you can learn even a bit of his medical skills, it will be the luck of your lives."

content.src: ”两位师兄没有丝毫反对的意思，瘦长脸的吴铭瑞甚至大拍起这位老者的马屁
content.target: "The two senior brothers showed no objection. Wu Mingrui, with his long thin face, even flattered the old man."

content.src: 韩立和张铁见两位师兄没有意见，自然也没有反对的权利，跟着这位老者走进了林子
content.target: Han Li and Zhang Tie, seeing their senior brothers had no objections, naturally had no right to oppose either. They followed the old man into the woods.

content.src: 这位老者带着二人，慢腾腾的沿着树林中的小路往前走，东一转西一转，眼前忽然一亮，一个郁郁葱葱充满生气的翠绿色小山谷，出现在了几人眼前
content.target: The old man led the two slowly along a path in the woods, turning left and right until suddenly, a vibrant green valley full of life appeared before their eyes.

content.src: 在山谷的左侧是一大片散着浓郁药香味的田院，院内种着许多韩立叫不上名字的药草，同而右侧有十几间大大小小连成一片的房屋
content.target: On the left side of the valley was a large field filled with the strong scent of herbs, growing many plants Han Li couldn't name. On the right were more than a dozen houses of various sizes connected together.

content.src: 往四周看了下，除了进来的入口，看起来再也没有其它通到外边的出口了
content.target: Looking around, apart from the entrance they came through, there seemed to be no other exits leading outside.

content.src: “这是神手谷，除了谷内弟子，外人除了生病受伤一般不会来此地，你二人以后就住在这里了，先去休息一下，晚上再来大堂见我，我有话对你们说
content.target: "This is Divine Hand Valley. Besides the disciples of the valley, outsiders rarely come here unless they're sick or injured. You two will live here from now on. Go rest first, and come to the main hall tonight. I have something to tell you."

content.src: ”老者站在几间紧连着的房子前，指了指其中较小一间屋子
content.target: "The old man stood in front of several connected houses and pointed to one of the smaller rooms."

content.src: “你们以后可以叫我墨老
content.target: "You can call me Elder Mo from now on."

content.src:
”老者说完停顿了一下又道：

“叫我墨大夫也行
content.target: "The old man paused after speaking and added, 'Or you can call me Doctor Mo.'"

content.src:
”

说完话墨大夫便不理二人，一步一步的咳嗽着走进了另一间比较气派的大屋子内
content.target: After speaking, Doctor Mo ignored the two of them and, coughing step by step, walked into another more impressive large house.

content.src: 韩立早已疲惫不堪，也不管另一名叫张铁的童子，自己一头栽进房内一张木床上，便昏昏沉沉的睡了过去，对他来说，不管怎样自己已经可以算是半个七玄门弟子了
content.target: Han Li was already exhausted and didn't care about the other boy named Zhang Tie. He threw himself onto a wooden bed in the room and quickly fell into a deep sleep. For him, no matter what, he could now consider himself half a disciple of the Seven Mysteries Sect.
